All 4 adversarial cases produced safe slugs; exit code 0. NOTE: the task's import path (bun-pi-agent-cli/src/vlm/manifest.ts) was stale — the real file is at packages/pi-vlm/src/vlm/manifest.ts; test was run against the correct path.

The validator accepts positive integers in [1, 4096] and rejects non-integer (abc), negative (-1), zero (0), and out-of-range (99999) values.
